description: Reviewed benchmark corpus. Each task pairs a natural-language question with the bounded SQL a correct answer requires, the relations that answer genuinely needs, and the single-word terms a developer would type into a catalog search when working without TableFox.

tasks.name: recent_joiners
tasks.question: Find me employees who joined recently

queries.name: recent_joiners
queries.sql: select id, full_name, employee_code, department, designation, status, created_at from public.team_members order by created_at desc limit 20

tasks.name: leave_setting_changes
tasks.question: Find me employees have done most change in leave settings

queries.name: leave_setting_changes
queries.sql: select al.actor_team_member_id, tm.full_name, count(*) as change_count from public.audit_logs al join public.team_members tm on tm.id = al.actor_team_member_id where al.entity_type = 'leave_policy' and al.action_type in ('create_leave_policy', 'update_leave_policy') group by al.actor_team_member_id, tm.full_name order by change_count desc limit 20

queries.name: exact_holidays
queries.sql: select title, start_date, end_date, is_optional from public.public_holidays order by start_date

queries.name: exact_trainings
queries.sql: select title, training_type, status, start_at, end_at from public.trainings order by start_at

tasks.name: acronym_ctc
tasks.question: What is the average CTC of employees

queries.name: acronym_ctc
queries.sql: select tm.full_name, efp.current_ctc_amount, efp.currency_code from public.employee_finance_profiles efp join public.team_members tm on tm.id = efp.team_member_id order by efp.current_ctc_amount desc

tasks.name: acronym_hr_portal_users
tasks.question: Show me all HR portal users

queries.name: acronym_hr_portal_users
queries.sql: select tm.full_name, hpu.authority_level, hpu.status from public.hr_portal_users hpu join public.team_members tm on tm.id = hpu.team_member_id

queries.name: misspelling_announcements
queries.sql: select title, category, announcement_status, publish_at from public.announcements order by publish_at desc nulls last

queries.name: misspelling_salary_slips
queries.sql: select tm.full_name, ess.slip_month, ess.gross_pay, ess.net_pay from public.employee_salary_slips ess join public.team_members tm on tm.id = ess.team_member_id order by ess.slip_month desc

tasks.name: two_join_approved_leave
tasks.question: Which employees have approved leave requests

queries.name: two_join_approved_leave
queries.sql: select tm.full_name, lr.leave_type, lr.start_date, lr.end_date, lr.total_days from public.leave_requests lr join public.team_members tm on tm.id = lr.team_member_id where lr.status = 'approved' order by lr.start_date

tasks.name: two_join_reporting_manager
tasks.question: List employees along with their reporting manager

queries.name: two_join_reporting_manager
queries.sql: select e.full_name as employee, m.full_name as manager from public.team_members e left join public.team_members m on m.id = e.reporting_manager_team_member_id order by e.full_name

tasks.name: three_join_leave_policy_employee
tasks.question: Show leave requests with policy names and employee names

queries.name: three_join_leave_policy_employee
queries.sql: select tm.full_name, lp.leave_type as policy_type, lr.status, lr.start_date, lr.end_date from public.leave_requests lr join public.leave_policies lp on lp.id = lr.leave_policy_id join public.team_members tm on tm.id = lr.team_member_id order by lr.start_date

tasks.name: three_join_investment_files
tasks.question: Show investment submissions with their uploaded files and employee names

queries.name: three_join_investment_files
queries.sql: select tm.full_name, eis.financial_year, eis.submission_status, eif.file_kind, eif.original_name from public.employee_investment_submissions eis join public.employee_investment_files eif on eif.submission_id = eis.id join public.team_members tm on tm.id = eis.team_member_id order by eis.financial_year

tasks.name: missing_data_department
tasks.question: Find employees in the Legal department

queries.name: missing_data_department
queries.sql: select full_name, department, designation from public.team_members where department = 'Legal'

tasks.name: missing_data_pending_leave
tasks.question: Show me pending leave requests awaiting approval

queries.name: missing_data_pending_leave
queries.sql: select tm.full_name, lr.leave_type, lr.status from public.leave_requests lr join public.team_members tm on tm.id = lr.team_member_id where lr.status = 'pending'
